name: speakr
description: Speakr is a personal, self-hosted web application designed for transcribing audio recordings
readme_summary: Speakr is a self-hosted web application for transcribing audio recordings into searchable and organized notes. It prioritizes privacy by running entirely on user infrastructure and offers advanced features like speaker diarization and custom vocabulary.
key_features: Flexible audio input (microphone, system audio, file uploads)
Long recording sessions with streaming to server
Multiple ASR engine support (WhisperX, OpenAI, Mistral, etc.)
Speaker diarization and voice profile recognition
Automatic summary generation with customizable prompts
primary_use_case: Transcribing and organizing audio recordings for personal or group use, with a focus on privacy and intelligent note-taking.
cover_image_prompt: A wise old librarian meticulously organizing a vast library of spoken words. Audio waveforms are depicted as scrolls unfurling from a magical microphone, which the librarian is carefully transcribing onto digital pages. Each page glows with searchable text and highlights key action items. Small, subtle UI elements resembling a clean web interface are visible on a nearby desk, alongside floating digital particles representing AI analysis. The library setting is warm and inviting, with soft, focused lighting. The overall style is a 3D isometric illustration with a clean, modern aesthetic, emphasizing clarity and organization.

name: OpenStock
description: OpenStock is an open-source alternative to expensive market platforms. Track real-time prices, set personalized alerts, and explore detailed company insights — built openly, for everyone, forever free.
readme_summary: OpenStock is an open-source platform providing real-time stock market data, personalized alerts, and company insights. It aims to be a free and accessible alternative to expensive market data services.
primary_use_case: Tracking stock market prices and company information with customizable alerts.
cover_image_prompt: A wise old owl perched on a branch made of glowing stock tickers, holding a magnifying glass over a detailed company report. Below, a stream of real-time stock price data flows like a river, with small, colorful alert icons popping up. The owl's eyes subtly reflect a clean, modern dashboard interface. The background is a soft, abstract representation of a bustling financial district at dawn. The overall mood is one of knowledge, accessibility, and foresight. Rendered in a 3D isometric illustration style with a clean, vibrant color palette and subtle digital particle effects.

name: ESP-Drone
readme_summary: This repository provides the firmware and hardware design for a DIY ESP32 drone, initially focused on basic stabilization and Wi-Fi control. It has evolved into LiteWing, a developer-friendly drone development platform with advanced features like height and position hold.
primary_use_case: Building and controlling a customizable DIY drone using the ESP32 microcontroller, suitable for hobbyists and developers looking to experiment with drone technology.
cover_image_prompt: A miniature, sleek drone hovering confidently in a stylized, minimalist workshop. The drone is depicted mid-flight, with subtle glowing lines connecting it to a tablet screen held by an unseen hand, displaying intuitive flight controls and altitude readings. Small, ethereal data streams flow from the drone to the tablet, representing Wi-Fi control and sensor data. The background is a clean, modern workspace with faint blueprints of drone components visible. The overall mood is one of accessible innovation and technological empowerment. The art style should be a 3D isometric illustration with a clean, vibrant color palette, emphasizing clarity and a futuristic yet approachable feel. The repository name 'ESP-Drone' is subtly integrated into a small label on the tablet screen.

name: PokeTokenBar
description: Use your tokens to raise, evolve, and collect Pokémon! 🥚
readme_summary: PokeTokenBar is a macOS menu bar application that visualizes AI coding token usage by raising and evolving Pokémon. It tracks token spend, costs, and usage limits directly from local logs, providing an engaging way to monitor AI tool consumption.
key_features: Visualizes AI token usage as Pokémon companions
Tracks token spend, cost, and official 5-hour/weekly limits
Reads usage data directly from local logs (no external CLI needed)
Hatches, evolves, and collects Pokémon based on token usage
Features Shiny Pokémon and collectible Pokédex entries
Provides reset countdowns and burn-rate forecasts for limits
primary_use_case: To provide users with an engaging and visually intuitive way to track their AI coding token usage and associated costs within a macOS menu bar application.
cover_image_prompt: A vibrant 3D isometric illustration of a stylized macOS menu bar. From the menu bar, a digital stream of glowing data particles flows down into a small, stylized incubator. Inside the incubator, a cute, baby Pokémon is hatching from an egg. Around the incubator, subtle UI elements display graphs of token usage and countdown timers for usage limits. The overall mood is playful and informative, with a clean, modern aesthetic. The repository name 'PokeTokenBar' is subtly integrated into a small signpost in the scene. The color palette is bright and engaging, with blues, greens, and pops of yellow.

name: simplex-chat
description: SimpleX - the first messaging network operating without user identifiers of any kind - 100% private by design! iOS, Android and desktop apps 📱!
readme_summary: SimpleX Chat is a privacy-focused messaging platform that operates without any user identifiers, ensuring 100% privacy by design. It offers end-to-end encryption with an additional layer and provides mobile applications for iOS and Android, as well as a terminal-based client.
key_features: No user identifiers of any kind
Mobile apps for Android and iOS
Terminal (console) app/CLI for Linux, MacOS, Windows
primary_use_case: Secure and private communication without relying on user accounts or identifiers.
cover_image_prompt: A solitary, unadorned key floating in a vast, dark void, emitting a soft, secure glow. Around the key, ethereal, transparent streams of communication flow, each one distinct and unlinked to any identifiable source. Tiny, subtle digital particles representing encrypted data drift around the key, hinting at the underlying technology. The scene is minimalist and serene, emphasizing the absence of personal data and the inherent privacy. The overall mood is one of secure isolation and untraceable connection. The style should be a 3D render with a focus on atmospheric lighting and a dark, deep color palette with the key as the sole bright element.

name: Obtainium
description: Get Android app updates straight from the source.
readme_summary: Obtainium is an Android application that allows users to install and update applications directly from their source release pages, such as GitHub or GitLab. It provides notifications for new releases and supports a wide variety of app sources, including F-Droid, APKMirror, and direct APK links.
key_features: Install and update apps directly from source release pages
Supports GitHub, GitLab, F-Droid, and many other app stores/sources
Fallback HTML parsing for APK links
primary_use_case: To provide a decentralized and user-controlled method for obtaining and updating Android applications directly from their developers' release channels, bypassing traditional app stores.
cover_image_prompt: A friendly robot with a magnifying glass meticulously examining a series of small, glowing boxes labeled with app icons. The robot is carefully placing a 'verified' stamp on some boxes while gently pushing others aside. In the background, a stylized digital stream flows from various sources like GitHub and GitLab logos, feeding into a central 'Obtainium' hub. The scene is set in a clean, organized workshop with subtle circuit board patterns on the walls. The overall mood is one of diligent curation and security. The image should be a 3D isometric illustration with a bright, clean color palette and clear, friendly character design.
